lines.text: Thabo: "I've heard good things about Emberhold. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"Come get air with me. I need to think out loud."
"Sure. I'll be around."
"Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching?"
"Still figuring everyone out."
"Well. Same. But keep your eyes open — some people here are performing, not surviving."
"Take your time. I've got nowhere to be."
"Watch the quiet ones. Not the loud — the loud tell you everything. The quiet are either thinking or planning, and you can't tell which until it matters."
"Take your time. I've got nowhere to be."
"Come get air with me. I need to think out loud."
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
Thabo: "I've heard good things about Ashford. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"Come see what I found. You won't believe it."
"Right. Go on, then."
"You said you're still figuring everyone out. Figure anything out yet? Anyone you're watching?"
"Come see what I found. You won't believe it."
"Sure. I'll be around."
"What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"A full night's sleep. Just one. Where I don't wake up listening."
"God, yes. That's the dream now. Eight hours of not being afraid. Not that it matters."
"Take your time. I've got nowhere to be."
"A full night's sleep. Not safety, not answers — just eight hours where nothing needs me. That's my whole theology now."
"Take your time. I've got nowhere to be."
"I've heard good things about Ashford. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"All right. Let's ask them."
"All right — let's ask them." You carry the proposal to Ashford.
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
